peterxing.name: Peter Xing
peterxing.headline: Futurist, keynote speaker and technologist working at the intersection of AI, longevity science and human augmentation.
bio: Peter Xing helps organisations and individuals navigate, and flourish in, a time of accelerating change. He co-founded Transhumanism Australia, a venture studio and community that works with academic research institutions to accelerate projects for the global transhumanism movement, from Transhuman Coin to investing in founders with WAVIA (formerly SingularityU Australia).

Peter is Singularity Group expert faculty and a TEDx speaker, and previously worked as a Global Director on emerging technology initiatives at KPMG and Deloitte. He is the author of the upcoming book The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Singularity, which helps everyone prepare for a superintelligent AI future, and publishes The Singularity Daily, a three-minute show on the last 24 hours in AI, at peterxing.com.

help.title: Keynote speaking
help.text: Keynotes at technology conferences on transhumanism, AI and the singularity, and emerging technologies. Peter has spoken at TEDxMelbourne, StartCon, Real Big Things, Rising Minds, Convergence, Gamechangers Summit, CEBIT Australia, Vivid Sydney and Singularity summits in Australia, South Africa and Colombia.

help.title: Facilitating workshops
help.text: Design-thinking workshops that help leaders understand what emerging technologies mean for their organisation and their lives, and how to seize the opportunities.

peterxing.communities: Peter has collaborated with hundreds of tech communities: future thinkers and educators (Singularity University, General Assembly), conference organisers (SXSW, StartCon, TEDxMelbourne), biohackers (BioFoundry, Grindhouse Wetware), life-extension advocates (Humanity+, Lifespan.io, London Futurists, Longecity), neurotech researchers (UTS), XR, blockchain and space communities, basic-income and effective-altruism groups, and startup mentors (Founder Institute, USYD Incubate, Slingshot, Stone & Chalk). Together, we are building a world of abundance.

alysesue.name: Alyse Sue
alysesue.role: Co-founder, Transhumanism Australia and Transhuman Coin
alysesue.headline: Tech founder, web3 entrepreneur and software engineer.
bio: Alyse is a sought-after keynote speaker on web3, the metaverse, AI and transhumanism. She co-founded Transhumanism Australia and Transhuman Coin, a decentralised finance startup that supports projects using science and technology to overcome the limitations of human biology.

She has co-founded three ventures, including a genomic data machine-learning startup, mentored founders at CSIRO's ON accelerator, and was a founding member of KPMG's Innovate team. Forbes and Cointelegraph have covered her work building KPMG's metaverse business.
